pure-announcement.rationale: It is a documentation homepage for an existing library, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The nearby eval concepts (acceptability-envelope, golden-dataset retrieval evals) are methodology notes that overlap in topic only; neither covers the Ragas library itself.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Its claims about what the library does are directly checkable against the open-source package and linked docs.

durability.rationale: The page is slogan-level marketing copy ('from vibe checks to eval loops') plus doc links and a consulting pitch; every substantive detail lives behind links, leaving nothing here that stays useful as the product churns.

actionability.rationale: The only actions offered are product-only pointers — follow the quickstart, use the decorator API, book a consulting slot — with none of the how actually present in the note.

atomicity.rationale: It states exactly one thing — Ragas is an LLM-app evaluation framework built around experiments and LLM-driven metrics — with no separable bundled ideas.
